en: Black-and-white photograph showing six well‑dressed adults standing outdoors by a wooden fence in front of a powerful river or waterfall in a forested area. The men wear suits, long coats, and hats; the woman wears a dress, coat, and cloche-style hat, suggesting early 20th‑century fashion. Coniferous trees line the bank and the water appears white and turbulent, indicating rapids or a large waterfall. There is no visible printed caption or text on the front.
